# Archive fixtures

`rar5-subdirs.rar` is an unmodified fixture from
[markokr/rarfile](https://github.com/markokr/rarfile/blob/master/test/files/rar5-subdirs.rar).
It contains small text files in nested directories, including Unicode and spaces.
See `rarfile-LICENSE` for its ISC license.

ZIP and 7z test inputs are generated from synthetic content in temporary directories.
